📝 Notes
Feb 25, 2026
R&D daily sprint
Invited Amir Houieh Unbody io Noémi Biró Gabor Kerekes
Attachments R&D daily sprint 
Meeting records Transcript 
Summary
The team discussed resolving a "body" system issue caused by a website page with 6.5 million characters that overwhelmed the system, leading to a discussion on system architecture where Amir Houieh and Gabor Kerekes emphasized the importance of isolated components over the current architecture, which requires everything to work together. Regarding deployment tasks, Amir Houieh needs to fix the website image deployment, review content, and look into alternative solutions to Versel, while Gabor Kerekes is defining the scope for the myelium project and needs to test analytics permissions with Amir Houieh due to an error. Noémi Biró followed up on the contract sent to Melissa, requested Amir Houieh to implement a feature to export user time spent in the app, and also plans to review the Kira document to assess potential scope increases, with the team also agreeing that Amir Houieh should create a simple non-code prototype for the OS project vision by Friday.
Details
Resolution of Body System Issue: The team discussed an issue with the "body" system where one of the websites being crawled by carefinder contained a page with 6.5 million characters that overwhelmed the process (00:00:00). This issue, which involved a spam repellent page, caused the system to fail and prevented "viate" from properly cleaning up the created shards. The problem was eventually isolated by rewriting the crawling part for stories, leading to a notice from the cloud service about the large character count (00:05:10).
Discussion on System Architecture and Isolation: The conversation shifted to principles of engineering, specifically the importance of building systems where components can work in isolation. Amir Houieh noted that the current architecture, attributed to "Hussein," often requires everything to work together as a machine, which goes against their preference for having isolated components like functions (00:06:26). Gabor Kerekes supported this, citing that complex systems should evolve from simpler, testable parts, drawing a parallel to building with Legos (00:07:29).
Physical Training and Functional Patterns: Noémi Biró shared they are focused on functional patterns training, which involves exercises isolated initially and then integrated into overall movement. This approach was likened to the Lego analogy previously discussed. Gabor Kerekes mentioned knowing a physiotherapist in Rotterdam who specializes in functional patterns and fascia focus, which they offered to connect to Amir Houieh (00:08:40).
Website Deployment and Review Tasks: Amir Houieh mentioned that Versel failed and they still need to fix the image on deployment for the website. The team established several tasks for the website launch, including reviewing and cutting out some blog posts, checking the deployed version on phones, and giving Noémi Biró time to add content to the landing page (00:10:59). Amir Houieh also plans to look into alternative deployment solutions to Versel, although Gabor Kerekes noted they already set up Cloudflare (00:12:23).
Project Updates and Myelium Planning: Gabor Kerekes reported continuing work on defining the technical scope and a good "slice" for the myelium project (00:12:23). They also agreed to discuss the "inhab project" separately (00:13:50).
Analytics Permissions and Testing: The group noted that testing the analytics permissions for Amir Houieh still needed to be done with Gabor Kerekes, as Amir Houieh was receiving an error. Gabor Kerekes suggested that they should perform this testing separately (00:13:50).
OS Project Brainstorming and Prototyping: The team decided that a brainstorming session on the OS project was premature, as more time was needed to process the ideas. They agreed that Amir Houieh should create a simple, non-code prototype using a tool like Gemini's AI studio to visually communicate their vision for the interface, comparing it to "Photoshopping" the concept (00:14:59). They scheduled this development session for Friday, reserving Fridays for mini-workshops or working sessions (00:16:15).
Time Spent Tracking and Contract Follow-up: Noémi Biró asked Amir Houieh to update the time spent in the app and followed up on the contract sent to Melissa. Amir Houieh confirmed they sent the contract on Monday and planned to send a reminder today (00:17:23). Noémi Biró clarified that the task is to export the time a user spends in the app during one session, and Amir Houieh committed to implementing this (00:18:26).
Task Management Tool Selection: Gabor Kerekes raised the need to agree on a single place for task management to ensure consistency (00:18:26). Noémi Biró stated a preference for Notion, noting they have kept it up to date during the current four-week period (00:19:39).
Fixing Permissions and Reviewing Kira Document: The meeting concluded with Gabor Kerekes instructing Amir Houieh to remain so they could fix the permission issues. Noémi Biró planned to read the Kira document that Melissa had sent to understand a conclusion that might increase the required scope of work (00:20:42).
Suggested next steps
Noémi Biró will add something to the landing page of the website.
Amir Houieh will look into other solutions than Versel for the website deployment and send a reminder to Melissa regarding the contract.
Amir Houieh will update the time spent of a user in one session in the app analytics.
The group will check the online version of the website on their phones, review the content, and flag any blog posts that should be removed.
